summary: A static UUID keeps an event stream's URL https://<eda-server>/api/eda/v1/external_event_stream/{uuid}/ the same after the service is recreated, for disaster recovery. It must be unique and makes URLs predictable, so use it only with strong auth (HMAC, mTLS) and network restrictions; normally use generated UUIDs.
questions: Can I keep my event stream webhook URL after recreating it?
What is a static UUID for an event stream?
Is it safe to use a static UUID for event streams?
